modes.name: One shared phone
modes.tagline: nothing to hide — pass it between moves

help.goal: Trap the other king so it has no way out of check. Checkmate wins the game.
steps: Wait until the top line says your move.
Tap one of your pieces to light up its squares.
Tap a highlighted square to move there.
On one shared phone, pass it after every move.
Tap Resign 🏳️ to hand the game to your opponent.
notes: A pawn reaching the far row always becomes a queen. There is no choice of piece.
Play alone and a bot takes the empty seat: Easy plays loose, Normal looks ahead, Hard searches deeper.
Draws happen on stalemate, threefold repetition, the fifty move rule, or too few pieces.
